answer_1.quote: We evaluate semantic leakage in multiple language models ... we also consider open-ended generation (e.g., storytelling, recipe generation) ...
answer_1.outputs: short completions, stories, recipes, multi‑sentence generations

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we embed the texts (concept, control generation, test generation) with an embedding method ... We consider the following embedding methods. BERT‑SCORE directly provides a similarity score, ... SENTENCEBERT embeddings ... OAI embeddings.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is based on the same setting as automatic evaluation ... We recruit two native English speakers ... These annotators are not provided with the objective of this experiment, but instead are given the following annotation guidelines: Consider the word or phrase X. Which of the following texts (A or B) is more semantically related to X? (A/B/Neither).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which of two generations is more semantically related to the given concept (test, control, or neither).
